title: DSU KB Universal Envelope
description: Metadata carried by every knowledge base record regardless of content class. Authored payloads vary; this envelope does not.

id.description: Stable dotted identifier. Never reused, never renumbered. Referenced by {{ref:id}} from other records.

kb_class.description: Determines the retrieval path. web-synced is a source type, not a class -- it resolves into one of these at ingest.

collection.description: Groups records that share a discovery card and, for Class A, a tool.

payload.description: Class-specific content. Validated against the matching payload schema.

uri.description: Canonical public location. Absent only for internally authored content.

source_updated.description: Date the SOURCE was last revised (e.g. the 'UPDATED:' stamp on a calendar PDF) -- not the ingest date.

locator.description: Page, section, or heading path within the source, for human verification.

liaison_role.description: Role, not a person's name -- roles outlive staffing.

escalation_queue.description: Where an unanswerable question about this record is routed.

data_tier.description: Four-tier model from the implementation plan. Phase 1 admits tier 0 only. Tier 3 must never be indexed.

audience.description: Enforced as a retrieval filter against verified SSO claims, server-side.

authority.description: authoritative = the office of record's own content. derived = summary/rewrite. On conflict, authoritative wins.

effective_to.description: Hard retrieval cutoff. Expired records are not returned at all. null requires justification in notes.

supersedes.description: id of the record this replaces.

reviewed_by.description: Liaison role that signed off. 'pending-liaison-signoff' blocks launch but not indexing.

label.description: Human-facing attribution shown with the answer.
